metric: minimum sum of Euclidean preteleport movement lengths on a finite portal-state graph
units: pixels; teleport jump length excluded, following environment route_length
directions: 16: axis, diagonal, (2,1)/(1,2) and sign variants; local exact-point connectors and zero actions
exact_extra_positions: 210 model-query centers, four references, four portal landings, four endpoints
physics: same-room segments; mandatory swept radius10 trigger; pairing0; exact14px landing; locked destination until distance>=28
state: position and locked endpoint; plotted queries initially unlocked
goal: exact reference position in either leaf, with any lock; not the 16px environment success set
approximation: shortest paths are exact on the finite graph, not continuous-action optimal distances or calibrated latent energies
extra_connections: Each additional node connects bidirectionally to its 16 nearest same-room dense-lattice centers; exact special-node pairs also connect when each displacement component is at most 5 px.
movement_bound: Every graph action is (proposed_position-current_position)/5 with each component in [-1,1].
